requirements: R1: Implement real-time auto-suggestions and typo correction in the search bar

slices.title: Patch search input for real-time auto-suggestions
slices.jtbd: When implementing auto-suggestions for this epic, I want to add real-time dropdowns to the search input, so that the epic's outcome is achieved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search input field,
When a user starts typing,
Then the system returns a list of suggested queries or matching document titles.
Given an automated UI test,
When auto-suggestions are triggered,
Then the UI test verifies that real-time dropdown renders correctly without regressions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce search refinement steps from 4 to 1

requirements: R1: Enable offline material creation with automatic synchronization upon reconnection

slices.title: Patch frontend state for offline creation and sync
slices.jtbd: When implementing offline creation for this epic, I want to store materials locally, so that the epic's outcome is achieved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an offline state,
When a user creates or modifies a document,
Then it is stored locally and automatically pushed to the server upon reconnection.
Given an integration test for offline sync,
When a reconnection event occurs,
Then it verifies that locally stored materials are pushed to the server.
slices.tocConstraintRef: frontend service worker or local storage
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce data loss in offline states from 5% to 0%
